text:
32 yo F with acute low back pain after lifting boxes 3 days ago. Denies DM/HTN. No red flags, no saddle anesthesia.
Dx: acute mechanical low back pain.
Plan: ibuprofen 400 mg q8h PRN pain x 7 days, heat. Return if symptoms worsen or numbness develops.
